candidate_source.note: Frozen corrected owner-multiplicity candidate (v3). Exact staged patch and source snapshots retained. Earlier unmeasured source/build drafts remain in v1-unmeasured and v2-unmeasured. Baseline source matches prior cycle21 production artifact and git HEAD.

node.scope: One reference per workload, not a distribution

comparison.method: Four balanced fresh-process pairs; Student-t 95% interval on paired log ratios. Primary application elapsed_ms; complete solver process wall_ms. CPU and process wall tested independently.

peak_memory.method: Four balanced fresh-process pairs; Linux wait4 ru_maxrss in KiB. Student-t 95% paired log interval; no post-GC retained memory claim.

diagnostics.scope: One instrumented complete solver run per artifact after all timing and peak runs; diagnostic timings are not acceptance measurements. Opcode output lists only the most frequent helpers; absence is not zero. Native durations are inclusive of callbacks and nested work.

inference.basis: The solver uses two-element prefixes. ArrayBindingStep count / 2 equals the observed GetIter helper reduction.

regression_policy.rule: Independent metric median loss above 3% and paired Student-t 95% log interval excluding parity in the slower direction.

validation.final_source: v3 corrected owner-multiplicity source, frozen before release build and acceptance measurements
